messages:
Maya: quick heads-up — noticed sustained memory growth on rt-ml-42 during longctx runs. looks tenant 'alpha' residency creeping past soft quota and triggering eviction storms that ripple to other tenants. attaching a couple quick metrics below. :eyes:
AJ: can you paste the pprof / heap or a sampling of the metrics?
Maya: pasted metric snapshot:
```
tenant_residency_bytes{tenant="alpha"} 12345678912  # ~11.5GB
tenant_quota_bytes{tenant="alpha"} 8589934592    # 8GB soft
page_evictions_total 4321
kv_pagewalk_ops/s 1280
longctx_active_sessions 97
residency_reuse_score_avg 0.18
fragmentation_ratio 0.18
```
AJ: yikes, reuse_score is low and fragmentation ~18% — that explains the growth when long contexts keep grabbings pages then never reuse.
Dina: two quick possible levers: 1) soft probation window for high-residency tenants (slow-decay on residency signal) so quota enforcement isn't binary; 2) background compaction that prefers low-reuse pages.
Sasha: on a past incident we saw pinned pages from function-call streaming prevent compaction. check if the pin expiry hooks are firing for alpha. pprof stack traces pointed to kv_page_pin and slab_refcount++ lingering.
perf-bot: ALERT: tenant_residency_exceeding_soft_quota (rt-ml-42, tenant=alpha) — routed to #eng-runtime oncall.
Liam: short mitigation idea: temporarily lower alpha soft quota by 10% and enable aggressive eviction scoring for that tenant; schedule background compaction during low-traffic window.
AJ: here's a small eviction scoring tweak we can try as a canary (pseudo):
```
score = base_age_weight * age + reuse_weight * (1 - reuse_score) + frag_penalty * fragmentation
if tenant_residency > soft_quota: score += noisy_neighbor_penalty
```
AJ: basically bias against low-reuse + high-frag pages and add a soft penalty when residency > soft_quota so eviction targets shift away from healthy tenants.
Maya: will run that patch on two canary hosts (rt-ml-42, rt-ml-43) and replay the longctx workload with 1.2x seq length ramp. will also enable extra counters: per-tenant page_eviction_by_cause and per-tenant fragment_pct.
Dina: add dashboard panels: tenant_residency_bytes (top 30), residency_ratio, eviction_rate_by_tenant, reuse_score_histogram. set an alert: residency_ratio > 1.15 for >5m.
Sasha: FYI pprof snapshot I grabbed earlier — wall allocs concentrated in kv_pagewalk (dominant) and slab_reuse. flamegraph attached in thread (will upload after canary run). fragmentation hotspots at ~0x7ff... map to slab allocator churn.
Maya: good. if canary looks stable we'll flip scoring globally and add a soft-quota rollback policy (auto-relax if tail latency increases).
Liam: also consider making per-tenant probation window configable per-ramp (prod vs dev tenants).
AJ: small test we should run locally: script that opens N longctx sessions for tenant alpha, then spike shortctx sessions from other tenants and watch eviction heat. helps reproduce cross-tenant noisy neighbor pattern.
Maya: noted. I'll own the canary + dashboards. will post preliminary numbers in ~2h. :thumbsup:
Dina: thanks — if canary fails, revert scoring and enable immediate compaction.
Sasha: leaving a note to audit pin/unpin paths — if expiry hooks are broken that's a separate bug we should hotfix.
Maya: acknowledged, will include pin/unpin traces in the canary artifact.
perf-bot: NOTE: scheduled run by Maya at 2433213600 (canary window).
Maya: thanks all — will update thread with 1) before/after residency graphs 2) eviction-by-cause breakdown 3) pprof flamegraphs.
